title: Papyrus relevance through Cyclotron in shadow mode
description:
## Goal (Papyrus repo, with the Cyclotron repo; tracked here as part of the review follow-through)
Route Papyrus source relevance through Cyclotron in shadow mode and measure it before relying on it.

## Plan
1. Papyrus opens a `papyrus-relevance` cyclotron as shown in Cyclotron `docs/embedding.md` (single classifier: "Should this source become a reference for this publication?", positive label include). Seed the rubric from the publication doctrine. Use an exclusive Assignment claim as the single-writer lease.
2. For each reference, Biblicus supplies extracted text and web metadata (that is the application transformer Cyclotron expects). The Cyclotron decision is recorded next to the current 1 to 5 quality rubric in `reference_curation_signals.py`. It does not change any editorial outcome.
3. Editor accept or reject becomes a review (`cyclotron.review`).
4. After enough real reviews, compare Cyclotron's accuracy and calibration with the rubric on the same items. Promote only if it wins; record the numbers.
5. Then repeat for steering proposal acceptance.

## Done when
Shadow decisions are recorded for every new reference and a written comparison on real editor labels exists.

comments.author: home
comments.text: 2026-10-19 audit of Papyrus origin/main (a35694b5). Done: step 1 (papyrus-relevance cyclotron seeded from doctrine, AssignmentClaimLease in relevance_sweep.py), step 3 (editor accept/reject -> cyclotron.review, relevance_sweep.py:598), shadow recording with live agreement (relevance_shadow.py, PR 298/304). Not done: (a) no comparison of Cyclotron against the 1-5 quality rubric (reference_curation_signals.py:64 QUALITY_ASSESSMENT_RUBRIC still present and feeds ranking); the only proof is lib/approved-priming-proofs/papyrus.json, 10 held-out sources, agreement 0.9 at 13 labels, no calibration values, no rubric baseline. (b) step 5, steering proposal acceptance through Cyclotron: nothing exists. Remaining work: pair each shadow decision with quality_rating_is on the same reviewed References, n well above 10, record accuracy and calibration for both, then decide promotion. Then step 5. Opt-in auto-reject of clear misses (PR 358) already gates on a fresh proof.
